title: His ways are higher

verses.text: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways are higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts.
O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!

caption:
You can trust a wisdom you are not able to trace.

Isaiah does not hand us God's reasons. He gives us the distance between His thinking and ours, and then calls that distance higher. What feels like a closed door may be a kindness you cannot see the shape of yet.

Isaiah 55:8, 55:9, Romans 11:33 (BSB)
